hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */frontend/*.ts|*/frontend/*.tsx|*/frontend/*.js|*/frontend/*.jsx|*/frontend/*.css|*/frontend/*.json|*/frontend/*.md) fdir="${f%%/frontend/*}/frontend"; "$fdir/node_modules/.bin/prettier" --write "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
